title: PRAISE: A Reproducible Workflow for Non-Programmer Scientists to Implement Published AI Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models are increasingly developed, published and used across scientific fields. Researchers, students and industry professionals who want to apply these models to their own research questions often lack the programming and data science expertise to do so. Existing guidelines cover single steps, but not the route from a published model to working predictions on one's own data. Here we present the hands-on workflow PRAISE, a Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education, that helps non-programmers implement published AI models step by step. Because implementations rarely work the first time, PRAISE anticipates common failures and provides a fallback route for each. translated_title: PRAISE：面向非程序员科学家实施已发表AI模型的可复现工作流
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）模型正日益在各科学领域被开发、发表和使用。希望将这些模型应用于自己研究问题的研究人员、学生和行业从业者，往往缺乏所需的编程和数据科学专业知识。现有指南仅涵盖单个步骤，却未提供从已发表模型到自己数据上成功获得预测结果的完整路径。本文提出了动手实践工作流PRAISE（Practical, Reproducible AI-model Implementation for Science and Education，即“科学与教育中实用、可复现的AI模型实施”），帮助非程序员逐步实施已发表的AI模型。由于模型实施很少能一次成功，PRAISE预见了常见的失败情况，并为每种情况提供了备用解决方案。作为原理验证，三名化学本科生及其导师在没有任何编程或数据科学知识的情况下应用了PRAISE，复现、验证并扩展了一个预测酶（活性）的最先进模型。
tldr: PRAISE是一个帮助没有编程经验的科学家分步实施已发表AI模型的可复现工作流，它为常见失败提供备用方案，并由三名无编程背景的化学本科生成功验证。
en_tdlr: PRAISE is a reproducible, step-by-step workflow that enables non-programmer scientists to implement published AI models, providing fallback routes for common failures, and was successfully validated by three chemistry undergraduates without programming experience.
